remarks:
Fresh renovation work meets classic country character at 5377 Tolan Road in Ellicottville. This updated 3-bedroom home has been completely transformed inside with today’s clean modern finishes while still keeping that small-town Western New York charm buyers love. Bright open living spaces, new flooring, fresh paint, updated trim work, stylish lighting, and a fully remodeled kitchen with stainless appliances, modern cabinetry, and oversized counter space give this home a move-in ready feel from the second you walk in. The updated bath design brings a high-end touch with marble-style tile work and modern black fixtures that stand out immediately. The layout offers comfortable year-round living or the perfect getaway property just minutes from everything that makes Ellicottville special. Enjoy a brand-new oversized deck for summer evenings, mountain air, entertaining, or relaxing after a day on the slopes. The setting delivers a peaceful country feel with surrounding hillsides and nature all around, yet you are still a short drive to HoliMont, Holiday Valley, golf, mountain biking, restaurants, nightlife, shopping, and four-season events in the Village of Ellicottville. The updated laundry area, refreshed bedrooms, and open flow throughout the home make this property easy to enjoy immediately without the heavy lifting of renovation work. 
This is the kind of property buyers continue searching for in Ellicottville — modern updates, manageable size, country atmosphere, and close access to ski country living.
